## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
version             needs  score
bf16 · nvidia only  ~24GB   48.7
</pre>

```sh
# bf16 · nvidia only
git clone https://github.com/PKU-YuanGroup/Open-Sora-Plan && cd Open-Sora-Plan && git checkout v1.3.1 && pip install -e . && hf download LanguageBind/Open-Sora-Plan-v1.3.0 --include 'any93x640x640/*' 'vae/*' --local-dir osp13 && hf download google/mt5-xxl --local-dir mt5-xxl && torchrun --nnodes=1 --nproc_per_node 1 -m opensora.sample.sample --model_path osp13/any93x640x640 --version v1_3 --num_frames 93 --height 352 --width 640 --text_encoder_name_1 mt5-xxl --text_prompt examples/sora.txt --ae WFVAEModel_D8_4x8x8 --ae_path osp13/vae --save_img_path ./samples --fps 18 --guidance_scale 7.5 --num_sampling_steps 100 --max_sequence_length 512 --sample_method EulerAncestralDiscrete --seed 1234 --num_samples_per_prompt 1 --rescale_betas_zero_snr --prediction_type v_prediction --save_memory
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
